blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine stocks could face renewed pressure this week as investors weigh another interest rate hike against rising oil prices and a weaker peso, according to F. Yap Securities Inc. In its outlook for Oct. 12 to 16, the brokerage urged investors to remain selective ahead of third-quarter earnings and the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas’ (BSP) policy meeting on Oct. 22. READ: Gasoline hikes, diesel rollback ahead On Friday, the benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) ended Friday at 5,700.99, up 1.61 percent for the session as bargain hunting lifted all sectors.
